question: Pinto went 12 km to the south from his house, then he turned east and covered 8 km, then he turned north and covered 6 km. Finally tuning to the west, he covered 13 km. In which direction is he from his house? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:

 
• Pinto went 12 km to the south from his house
 
• then he turned east and covered 8 km
 
• then he turned north and covered 6 km
 
• Finally tuning to the west, he covered 13 km.

​Now, according to the given information direction and distance diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b539a16fffffc8b96555ec6c5eff03e545b17f414925998ca7ebe00518013362.png] 

Now, finally Pinto is in the **South-west** direction from his house**.**

Hence, the correct answer is** 'South-west'.**
